# PerioVox

> Free AI voice periodontal charting software for dental professionals. Free today. Free forever.

PerioVox converts measurements dictated by a dental professional into a structured periodontal chart. It works in a web browser with an everyday periodontal probe and a compatible microphone, without additional hardware or a second person recording the measurements.

Voice dictation understands 97 languages. The application interface is available in Spanish, English and French. The website is available in Spanish and English.

Features include periodontal charts, visit comparisons, Lang diagrams, IDRA, patient reports with QR access, ADA and FDI tooth numbering, and CSV exports for audits and research.

EMS has placed its trust in PerioVox. Workflow options based on the EMS Guided Biofilm Therapy protocol are available in selected markets; availability varies by country.

PerioVox is ready to integrate with other practice management software as a plugin. An established collaboration with Orca, an AI-based practice management platform, includes an agreement to incorporate PerioVox as a plugin. This does not imply that an integration is already live. Learn about Orca at https://orca.clinic/.

PerioVox is an informational support tool. Clinicians retain responsibility for reviewing records, diagnosis and treatment decisions.
